nodes.content: Six source analytic assumptions and finite Hilbert/Borel carriers.
Actual phase joint-Borel, product-volume, inverses, reversal and rate identities.
Strict ordered simplex and actual finite prescribed endpoint.
Affine reverse-order complement rho preserves strict simplex and its measure; involutive.
Endpoint map jointly Borel in initial state and tuple under actual finite recursion.
P_reverse(R P_tau z)=R z; hence K squared is identity.
Each prescribed finite endpoint and R after endpoint preserves phase volume.
Joint endpoint/time reversal is measure-preserving measurable involution on phase x simplex.
A4 Gibbs-survival balance plus A5 jump factors under reversal.
Stationary averaging and weighted sector change of variables with Tonelli/signed decomposition.
Bounded bilinear skew balance then fixed-time Gibbs invariance.
Actual physical-time residual clock/restart needed for Markovness, not K97.
